Pathology Boxplot Type (Nature Aging / SciFig Style)

Source: R/type_boxplot.R
type_pathology_boxplot.Rd

Creates publication-grade pathology boxplots conforming to Nature Aging and SciFig standards (as seen in Yadav et al. 2026). Features semi-transparent boxes with status-matched borders, bold black horizontal medians, diamond mean markers, dotted trajectory lines connecting paired means across conditions, dashed zero reference baseline, and optional subsampling for large-cohort biological replicates.

Usage

type_pathology_boxplot(
  add_jitter = TRUE,
  jitter_width = 0.1,
  jitter_alpha = 0.35,
  jitter_size = 0.85,
  jitter_subsample = NULL,
  add_violin = FALSE,
  violin_alpha = 0.2,
  outlier_shape = NA,
  outlier_size = 1.5,
  width = 0.32,
  alpha = 0.22,
  linewidth = 0.45,
  position_dodge = 0.42,
  show_mean = TRUE,
  show_mean_line = TRUE,
  mean_shape = 23,
  mean_fill = "#FFFFFF",
  mean_color = "black",
  mean_size = 2,
  mean_stroke = 0.45,
  mean_line_lty = "dotted",
  mean_line_col = "grey45",
  mean_line_lwd = 0.38,
  bold_median = TRUE,
  bold_median_col = "#111111",
  bold_median_lwd = 0.85,
  zero_line = TRUE,
  zero_line_y = 0,
  zero_line_col = "grey75",
  zero_line_lty = "dashed"
)

Arguments

add_jitter

Add jittered points (default TRUE).

jitter_width

Width of jitter (default 0.15 for default, 0.10 for pathology, 0.12 for baranger).

jitter_alpha

Transparency of jittered points (default 0.38 for default, 0.35 for pathology, 0.65 for baranger).

jitter_size

Size of jittered points (default 1.6 for default, 0.85 for pathology, 1.8 for baranger).

jitter_subsample

Optional integer. When specified, subsamples up to `jitter_subsample` observations per category/group for jittered point display while computing boxplots and statistics on all data (ideal for large cohorts such as GTEx with N ~ 20k).

add_violin

Overlay violin plot (default FALSE for classic/pathology; default TRUE for Baranger style).

violin_alpha

Violin transparency (default 0.20 for classic, 0.30 for baranger).

outlier_shape

Shape for outlier points. Set to `NA` to hide outliers (publication style). Default `NA`.

outlier_size

Size of outlier points (default 1.5).

width

Box width (default 0.55 for default, 0.32 for pathology, 0.22 for baranger).

alpha

Box fill transparency (default 0.28 for default, 0.22 for pathology, 0.75 for baranger).

linewidth

Box outline width (default 0.65 for default, 0.45 for pathology).

position_dodge

Dodge width for grouped boxes. Default 0.8 for default/baranger, 0.42 for pathology style.

show_mean

Logical. Show mean marker diamond (default `TRUE` when `style = "pathology"`, `FALSE` otherwise).

show_mean_line

Logical. Show dotted connecting line between paired means within each x category (default `TRUE` when `style = "pathology"`, `FALSE` otherwise).

mean_shape

Shape for mean marker (default `23`, diamond).

mean_fill

Fill color for mean marker (default `"#FFFFFF"`, white).

mean_color

Border color for mean marker (default `"black"`).

mean_size

Size of mean marker (default `2.0`).

mean_stroke

Border thickness for mean marker (default `0.45`).

mean_line_lty

Linetype for paired mean connecting line (default `"dotted"`).

mean_line_col

Color for paired mean connecting line (default `"grey45"`).

mean_line_lwd

Linewidth for paired mean connecting line (default `0.38`).

bold_median

Logical. Draw a bold black horizontal line across each box for the median (default `TRUE` when `style = "pathology"`, `FALSE` otherwise).

bold_median_col

Color for bold median line (default `"#111111"`).

bold_median_lwd

Linewidth for bold median line (default `0.85`).

zero_line

Logical. Draw a horizontal reference line at y = 0 (default `TRUE` when `style = "pathology"`, `FALSE` otherwise).

zero_line_y

Intercept for zero reference line (default `0`).

zero_line_col

Color for zero reference line (default `"grey75"`).

zero_line_lty

Linetype for zero reference line (default `"dashed"`).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cliplot(delta ~ pathology | status, data = df_gtex,
        type = type_pathology_boxplot(),
        palette = "pathology", theme = "pathology")
} # }
